title: introduce-floodlight-regression-orchestrator-and-priority-prober-ci-hook
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Add Floodlight Regression Orchestrator + Priority Prober CI hook: enables prioritized sampling of prompt cohorts, shadow-run smoke gating, and automated triage suggestions for small regressions. No breaking changes.
description: Context: As prompt sets and multi-cohort evaluations grow, we need a lightweight orchestrator that can run prioritized probes (high-impact / high-frequency cohorts) across a staged CI path and surface triage suggestions when small regressions are detected. This PR introduces the Floodlight Regression Orchestrator (FloodlightOrchestrator) and a PriorityProber CI hook that implements prefix-weighted sampling and a compact impact scoring model. Motivation: earlier smoke gates either sampled naively or required full-run evaluations; Floodlight focuses compute on the smallest set of prompts that historically surface regressions while still preserving coverage for rare but severe failures. What this changes: - New orchestrator class, a small state machine to schedule probes and aggregate signals. - PriorityProber: a sampling policy that combines recent failure rate, token-weighted volume, and product-specified importance to produce a ranked probe queue. - CI hook (ci/hooks/floodlight-smoke.yml) to run a staged smoke path (fast local unit -> shadow-run -> gated soft-fail). - Compact impact score and triage hints in eval traces to aid on-call and eng triage. - Unit and integration tests + docs and config examples. Checklist: - [x] Implement orchestrator and prober - [x] Add unit tests (fast path) - [x] Add integration smoke test (shadow-run) - [x] Add CI workflow and gating policy - [x] Documentation and ops playbook - [x] Add Linear references and changelog Notes and tradeoffs: Floodlight uses a short historical window (default 7 days) and bias-corrects for sampling drift with a per-cohort recency weight. We intentionally minimize statefulness to keep the component easily deployable in hosted CI agents. Related: ENG-1284 (sampling policy research), ENG-1299 (smoke gating SLIs).

review_comments: Diego Ramos: Nice design. Can you add a brief benchmark showing hit-rate vs full-run for the top-50 cohorts? Concerned about bias on newly created prompts.

Asha Patel: Added a small micro-benchmark in tests that compares Floodlight top-k vs random sample; benchmark results included in integration test asserts (see test_floodlight_orchestrator.py). For new prompts we fall back to uniform sampling for the first 48 hours to avoid cold-start bias.
Claire Nguyen: Please wire tracing (trace_id) into orchestrator spans and ensure the CI hook emits trace links to the eval-trace service.
Asha Patel: Tracing added; FloodlightOrchestrator now emits span ids and the CI workflow posts trace URL on failure events.
Samir Khan: Add a short release note and confirm this won't increase CI timeouts for existing smoke jobs.
Asha Patel: Release note added; the new job is optional on older channels and defaults to 'shadow-run: false' on low-tier CI agents. We also cap the probe run to 120s per cohort to avoid long tails.
